source_documents.title: Aggregation enhanced excimer emission (AEEE) with efficient blue emission based on pyrene dendrimers

reference_evidence_units.quote: formed the organic analogues, dendrimers D3a,b and D5
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Demetallation of precursor D4; Scheme 4 and synthesis description.
reference_evidence_units.statement: D5 is the demetallated organic analogue, not one of the organoiron dendrimers used in electrochemical comparisons.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This establishes the source designation, not verification of the inherited SMILES.

reference_evidence_units.quote: there is no interaction between the two pyrenyl units in the ground state to form dimers.
reference_evidence_units.subject: D3a,b, D5, D9 and D13 in solution
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors use largely unchanged absorption shape to argue against ground-state dimers in these solution conditions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This does not exclude ground-state aggregation in high-water mixtures; an absorption-based assignment is not direct intermolecular-distance measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: When dendrimer D5 was excited at 343 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5
reference_evidence_units.statement: D5 shows pyrene monomer bands at 377 and 398 nm and an approximately 470 nm band enhanced by aggregation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Separate this target-specific result from the more extensively analyzed D3a and D3b.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The values were 0.54 in pure THF and 2.66 in the 1 : 9 THF/water mixture.
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Excimer/monomer intensity ratio in Figs. 18-19; excitation 343 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The reported excimer/monomer ratio increases from 0.54 to 2.66 with water-induced aggregation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A ratio of emission intensities is not an absolute fluorescence quantum yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the pyrene is attached directly to the zero generation without flexible chain.
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5 versus D3a/D3b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of dendrimer linkage design and spectra.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors distinguish D5 from the flexible-chain derivatives and relate its behavior to pyrene proximity and excimer formation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not copy the flexible-chain RIM explanation or its thresholds from D3a/D3b directly to D5.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This suggests that the excimer emission is due to intramolecular interactions
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source suggests intramolecular pyrene interactions contribute to excimer emission under aggregation conditions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The intramolecular assignment is tentative; no target-specific time-resolved separation from intermolecular excimers is demonstrated here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Transmission electron microscope images (TEM) for dendrimer D3a
reference_evidence_units.subject: D3a
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TEM images at different THF/water ratios, Fig. 24.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper's displayed morphology series is for D3a.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not present D3a particle sizes or micrographs as D5 measurements.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregation and pyrene proximity enable the excimer pathway. This is an overlapping environmental/arrangement description, not a separately proven rigidification mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target-specific long-wavelength emission and excimer/monomer ratio changes support the source's excimer explanation; intra- versus intermolecular contributions remain bounded.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not established by the selected target-related evidence in this source-led draft. This is not a claim of scientific impossibility.
